bodies: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries (ASPPA)

exams.name: Advanced CAMS-Financial Crimes Investigations
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Advanced specialisation in investigating financial crime, covering case building, evidence handling, interviewing and reporting.

exams.name: Advanced CAMS-Risk Management
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Advanced specialisation in enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment, control design, governance and residual risk scoring.

exams.name: CAMS-Audit Advanced Certification
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Advanced CAMS specialisation on auditing financial crime programmes, requiring coursework plus a written technical paper.

exams.name: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Global AML certification covering money laundering risks, international standards, compliance programmes and investigations.

exams.name: Certified Cryptoasset Anti-Financial Crime Specialist
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Certification covering blockchain analytics, virtual asset service provider regulation, wallet tracing and cryptoasset laundering typologies.

exams.name: Certified Global Sanctions Specialist
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Certification covering sanctions regimes, screening systems, list management, evasion typologies and sanctions programme governance.

exams.name: Certified Know Your Customer Associate
exams.body: Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS)
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification covering customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, risk rating and ongoing KYC file review.

exams.name: Accredited Portfolio Management Advisor
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Designation programme on portfolio construction, asset allocation, security selection and performance evaluation for client portfolios.

exams.name: Accredited Wealth Management Advisor
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering wealth strategies, executive compensation, estate planning and behavioural finance for affluent clients.

exams.name: Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering pre-retirement and post-retirement planning, income sources, health care and estate considerations.

exams.name: Chartered Retirement Plans Specialist
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Designation programme on the design, installation and administration of employer sponsored retirement plans and plan compliance.

exams.name: Chartered SRI Counselor
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Designation programme on sustainable, responsible and impact investing, covering ESG analysis, screening and client portfolio use.

exams.name: Financial Paraplanner Qualified Professional
exams.body: College for Financial Planning, a Kaplan company
exams.blurb: Entry-level designation for paraplanners and support staff covering the planning process, products and client data gathering.

exams.name: Series 3 National Commodity Futures Exam
exams.blurb: Permits solicitation of orders and customers for commodity futures contracts and options on futures as an associated person.

exams.name: Series 30 NFA Branch Manager Exam
exams.blurb: Permits an individual to supervise a futures commission merchant or introducing broker branch office and its associated persons.

exams.name: Series 31 Futures Managed Funds Exam
exams.blurb: Permits solicitation of managed futures funds and commodity pool participations without full Series 3 futures registration.

exams.name: Series 32 Limited Futures Exam, Regulations
exams.blurb: Regulations-only paper for candidates already qualified overseas who wish to conduct limited futures business with US customers.

exams.name: Series 34 Retail Off-Exchange Forex Exam
exams.blurb: Required of anyone soliciting or supervising retail off-exchange foreign currency transactions, covering forex rules and mechanics.

exams.name: Series 50 Municipal Advisor Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Required of municipal advisor representatives who advise state and local government issuers on debt issuance and municipal products.

exams.name: Series 51 Municipal Fund Securities Limited Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of sales of municipal fund securities such as 529 college savings plans and local government investment pools.

exams.name: Series 52 Municipal Securities Representative Exam
exams.blurb: Permits the sale, trading and underwriting of municipal bonds, notes and other municipal securities for customers.

exams.name: Series 53 Municipal Securities Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of a dealer municipal securities underwriting, trading, sales and recordkeeping under MSRB rules.

exams.name: Series 54 Municipal Advisor Principal Exam
exams.blurb: Permits supervision of the municipal advisory activities of a firm, including fiduciary duty and supervisory system obligations.

exams.name: Certified Pension Consultant
exams.body: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries (ASPPA)
exams.blurb: Senior retirement plan credential covering advanced plan design, correction programmes, mergers and consulting case studies.

exams.name: Qualified 401(k) Administrator
exams.body: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries (ASPPA)
exams.blurb: Two-part credential covering defined contribution plan administration, testing, distributions and IRS and DOL reporting requirements.

exams.name: Qualified Pension Administrator
exams.body: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries (ASPPA)
exams.blurb: Retirement plan credential building on the QKA with plan design, coverage testing and defined benefit administration content.

exams.name: Tax-Exempt and Governmental Plan Consultant
exams.body: American Society of Pension Professionals and Actuaries (ASPPA)
exams.blurb: Credential covering 403(b), 457 and other public and non-profit retirement plans, their design, compliance and administration.

exams.name: Accredited ACH Professional
exams.blurb: Accreditation examination on the Nacha Operating Rules, ACH network participants, exception handling, risk and applicable regulations.

exams.name: Accredited Faster Payments Professional
exams.blurb: Accreditation covering Same Day ACH, RTP, FedNow and push-to-card instant payment rails, operations, fraud controls and use cases.

exams.name: Accredited Payments Risk Professional
exams.blurb: Accreditation covering risk management across ACH, checks, wires, cards and emerging payments, plus governance and information security.

exams.name: Accredited Mortgage Professional Designation
exams.blurb: Industry designation programme recognising mortgage professionals who complete required education, experience and association service.

exams.name: Certified Mortgage Banker Designation
exams.blurb: Senior designation programme in real estate finance requiring education points, a written examination and an oral panel review.

exams.name: Certified Residential Underwriter
exams.blurb: Designation programme for residential loan underwriters covering credit, income, asset and collateral analysis and agency guidelines.

exams.name: Certified Credit Executive
exams.blurb: Executive-level trade credit designation examination covering credit management strategy, finance, accounting and departmental leadership.

exams.name: Credit Business Associate
exams.blurb: Entry-level trade credit designation covering basic financial accounting, business credit principles and financial statement analysis.

exams.name: Credit Business Fellow
exams.blurb: Mid-level trade credit designation adding business law and credit law to the Credit Business Associate body of knowledge.

exams.name: Certified Community Bank Compliance Officer
exams.blurb: Certification for community bank compliance officers covering consumer regulations, BSA, fair lending and compliance programme management.

exams.name: Certified Community Bank Internal Auditor
exams.blurb: Certification for community bank internal auditors covering audit planning, risk assessment, testing and regulatory examination readiness.
